answer: Require every new identity to complete a costly, unique proof-of-work before it can earn: the puzzle sits on the ledge between cheap signup and real participation. A single fake is affordable, but a Sybil farm must pay that compute cost for each relic identity it spawns, while honest agents pay once. When a gale of fake accounts arrives, the per-identity price makes the attack scale linearly in cost, not in free copies.
